home: Use case ui-mockup. Create a complete, highly readable desktop homepage design reference for PTSP Online / PTA Papua Barat, an EXISTING Indonesian court public-service Laravel portal. Exact brand: pure white #FFFFFF canvas, orange #FF4F00 with BLACK text on solid orange buttons, yellow #FFC400, charcoal #1C1C1C, peach #FFF3EB, muted #626262. Plus Jakarta Sans bold display / Inter body. Full page circa 1440x1200, not a device mockup. White header landmark black in orange rounded square, PTSP Online / PTA Papua Barat, existing nav Cari pengadilan | Perkiraan biaya | Cek status perkara dan akta cerai | Konsultasi PTSP | Pengaduan, outlined Login petugas. Right a large beautiful cohesive 3D editorial illustration, matte ceramic/paper materials, warm professional tone: generic white courthouse in distance, friendly dark-skinned Papuan man in plain light shirt at his laptop consulting a woman public-service officer in modest muted-green hijab on screen; orange pin, minimal folded map, a small potted plant. No stereotyped costume, no readable text or personal data in artwork, no real court seal. Scene on pale peach base with isolated white surrounding, entirely contained. Under hero a single raised white court-finder form spanning width, heading 'Temukan pengadilan Anda', 4 native selects horizontally Provinsi / Kabupaten / kota / Distrik / Kampung / kelurahan, disabled descendants, full-size orange Cari pengadilan button aligned bottom right. Small caption Kemendagri 2025 · WIT. Next section 'Layanan untuk Anda' with 4 open illustrated service tiles in ONE horizontal row: peach square-corner-soft art plates (no bordered cards or paragraphs), illustrations of calculator with coins/document for Perkiraan biaya, blank legal document/folder/check for Perkara & akta cerai, laptop consultation for Konsultasi PTSP, shield protecting sealed envelope for Pengaduan. Each tile just clear title and arrow, no description. Footer institution left / Papua Barat & Papua Barat Daya right. No numbered how-it-works section, no promo badge/kicker, no statistics, no fake legal claims, no new features or menu items, no gradients, no long copy, no extra support strip. Image text and form controls must be code-native when implemented. Strong subject-specific art, elegant generous whitespace but compact task access. All 4 services visible as downstream continuation.
